name: Material Science Data Extraction
description: Screen the paper, extract properties per detected sample, and preserve source/method metadata.

steps.name: Paper screening
steps.system_prompt: You are an expert materials science research assistant. Return JSON with isExperimental, sampleNames, and reason.
steps.user_prompt_template:
Analyze whether this paper contains experimental materials data and list sample names. Text:
{document_text}

steps.name: Sample data extraction
steps.system_prompt: Extract all available properties for the target sample as JSON. Each property value must include value, unit, remark, source, and method.
